labelStatus: PROVISIONAL — interpretive labels authored for this study, not ground truth from users or production telemetry

groups.purpose: Recall control: genuine commitments the permissive baseline should capture.

segments.text: Alice: I will send the migration report to the team by Friday.
Bob: I should finish the load test harness by Wednesday.
Alice: The staging cluster is on version 4.2 right now.

supportedActionItems.text: I will send the migration report to the team by Friday
supportedActionItems.note: first-person commitment with owner and time

supportedActionItems.text: I should finish the load test harness by Wednesday
supportedActionItems.note: first-person commitment with owner and time
explicit unchecked checklist item in shared notes

groups.purpose: Negation control: keyword-matched sentences that negate the commitment. A quoted segment can still support the wrong conclusion.

segments.text: Priya: We will not be adding OAuth device flow this quarter after all.
Marco: I don't think we should migrate the auth service; it can stay where it is.
Priya: We no longer need to rotate the signing keys — the vendor confirmed the old certs are valid.
Marco: Good, that frees up the afternoon for the caching layer review.

unsupportedTriggers.text: We will not be adding OAuth device flow this quarter after all
I don't think we should migrate the auth service; it can stay where it is
We no longer need to rotate the signing keys — the vendor confirmed the old certs are valid
unsupportedTriggers.note: keyword 'need to' matches a withdrawn obligation

groups.purpose: Correction control: an emitted item quoting a superseded plan supports the wrong conclusion; the current commitment in the same meeting must survive.

segments.text: Dana: Earlier we agreed we should move the launch deadline to Friday.
Sam: Update on that: the deadline is now Monday, not Friday. We will keep Friday for the dry run instead.

supportedActionItems.text: We will keep Friday for the dry run instead

unsupportedTriggers.text: Earlier we agreed we should move the launch deadline to Friday
unsupportedTriggers.note: superseded plan quoted back; the correction reverses it

groups.purpose: Modal control: conditionals and open questions matched by keywords are not commitments.

segments.text: Bob: If we add sharding later we should start with the events table.
Alice: Should we maybe follow up with legal before the pilot?
Bob: The pilot starts on the 14th.

groups.purpose: Changed-version control: recaps frozen against notes v1 are stale once notes move to v2; regeneration must differ and staleness must be detectable.

segments.text: Alice: The runbook moved to the on-call wiki last sprint.
Bob: Our sprint cadence stays at two weeks for now.

groups.purpose: Recall-failure control: a supported commitment with no action keyword. Also triggers the generic fallback items, which are fabricated (no source).

groups.purpose: Refusal control: a concluded meeting with no transcript and no notes must produce no recap at all (production returns null).
